blocks.zh: Chapter 3d: Process Equipment (3.2.10–end) / 製程設備（下）
blocks.en: Chapter 3d: Process Equipment (3.2.10–end)

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand the requirements for cleaning, disinfection, and sterilization of facility surfaces and equipment in sterile manufacturing. / 理解無菌製造設施與設備的清潔、消毒與滅菌要求。
blocks.en: Understand the requirements for cleaning, disinfection, and sterilization of facilities and equipment in sterile manufacturing.

blocks.zh: Distinguish between cleaning of critical parts (product-contact) and facility surfaces (non-product-contact). / 區分關鍵部件（產品接觸面）與設施表面（非產品接觸面）的清潔差異。
blocks.en: Distinguish between cleaning of critical parts (product-contact) and facility surfaces (non-product-contact).

blocks.zh: Evaluate the advantages, limitations, and implementation considerations of single-use systems. / 評估一次性系統的優勢、限制及導入考量。
blocks.en: Evaluate the advantages, limitations, and implementation considerations of single-use systems.

blocks.zh: Design effective equipment flow and cleaning equipment strategies (CIP, parts washers, ultrasonic). / 設計有效的設備流向與清潔設備策略（CIP、部件清洗機、超音波）。
blocks.en: Design effective equipment flow and cleaning equipment strategies (CIP, parts washers, ultrasonic).

blocks.zh: Apply steam sterilization (autoclave and SIP) design principles including air removal, condensate drainage, and qualification. / 應用蒸汽滅菌（高壓蒸汽鍋與SIP）設計原則，包括排氣、冷凝水排放與確效。
blocks.en: Apply steam sterilization (autoclave and SIP) design principles, including air removal, condensate drainage, and qualification.

blocks.zh: Understand considerations for other sterilization methods (VHP, gamma irradiation, EtO) and their facility impact. / 理解其他滅菌方法（VHP、伽瑪射線、環氧乙烷）及其對設施的影響。
blocks.en: Understand considerations for other sterilization methods (VHP, gamma irradiation, EtO) and their facility impact.

blocks.zh: 3.2.10 Cleaning, Disinfection and Sterilization 3.2.10 清潔、消毒與滅菌
blocks.en: 3.2.10 Cleaning, Disinfection and Sterilization

blocks.zh: 解讀與應用
blocks.en: Interpretation and Application

blocks.zh: 清潔與消毒的核心定位
blocks.en: The Core Role of Cleaning and Disinfection

blocks.zh: 清潔、消毒與滅菌是無菌製造設施的三道核心防線。ISPE Vol.3 把這些流程與製程設備章節放在一起討論，強調設備設計必須從一開始就考慮「如何清潔」與「如何滅菌」。
blocks.en: Cleaning, disinfection, and sterilization are the three core lines of defense in a sterile manufacturing facility. ISPE Vol.3 discusses these processes together with the process equipment chapter to stress that equipment design must consider, from the very beginning, how the equipment will be cleaned and how it will be sterilized.

blocks.zh: 術語混淆警告：消毒 vs. 殺菌
blocks.en: Terminology Warning: Disinfection vs. Sanitization

blocks.zh: Disinfection（消毒）與 Sanitization（殺菌）在行業中經常混用。FDA 使用 disinfection 作為標準用語。藥廠應在內部文件中明確定義並統一使用，避免稽核時產生疑慮。
blocks.en: Disinfection and sanitization are often used interchangeably in industry. FDA uses "disinfection" as the standard term. Companies should define and use one term consistently in their internal documents to avoid questions during audits.

blocks.zh: 比喻：餐廳廚房的清潔層次
blocks.en: Analogy: Cleaning Levels in a Restaurant Kitchen

blocks.zh: 想像一家高級餐廳：廚房地板每天擦洗（設施表面清潔），砤板與刀具每次用後徹底消毒（關鍵部件清潔），而整棟廚房定期大掃除（深層滅菌）。這與無菌製造的三層清潔策略完全對應。
blocks.en: Imagine a high-end restaurant: the kitchen floor is scrubbed every day (facility surface cleaning), cutting boards and knives are thoroughly disinfected after every use (critical part cleaning), and the whole kitchen gets a periodic deep clean (deep sterilization). This maps directly onto the three-tier cleaning strategy in sterile manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 消毒劑管理四要素
blocks.en: Four Elements of Disinfectant Management

blocks.zh: 無菌（Sterile）：消毒劑本身不能是污染源
blocks.en: Sterile: the disinfectant itself must not be a source of contamination

blocks.zh: 適當容器：避免轉移過程中引入微生物
blocks.en: Appropriate containers: avoid introducing microorganisms during transfer

blocks.zh: 標籤與效期：追溯性與有效性的基礎
blocks.en: Labeling and expiry: the basis of traceability and effectiveness

blocks.zh: 使用時限：開封後的消毒劑不是永遠有效
blocks.en: In-use time limit: an opened disinfectant does not stay effective forever

blocks.zh: CDMO 實戰：多產品線消毒策略標準化
blocks.en: CDMO in Practice: Standardizing the Disinfection Strategy Across Product Lines

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，操作多條產線時，建議建立「消毒劑矮陣」——統一核准的消毒劑清單與輪替計畫，適用於所有生產套件，減少每條產線各自驗證的重複成本。
blocks.en: In a CDMO operating multiple lines, it is advisable to establish a "disinfectant matrix": a single approved list of disinfectants and a rotation plan applicable to all production suites, which reduces the duplicated cost of each line validating its own.

blocks.zh: 關鍵部件清潔的時間壓力
blocks.en: Time Pressure on Critical Part Cleaning

blocks.zh: 關鍵部件必須在使用後「短時間內」清潔，這是因為產品殘留物會隨時間乾燥固化，大幅增加清潔難度。建立 Dirty Hold Time（臟污保留時間）與 Clean Hold Time（潔淨保留時間）是清潔驗證的基礎。
blocks.en: Critical parts must be cleaned "within a short time" after use, because product residues dry and harden over time, greatly increasing the difficulty of cleaning. Establishing the Dirty Hold Time and Clean Hold Time is the foundation of cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: 內毒素控制：綜合策略
blocks.en: Endotoxin Control: An Integrated Strategy

blocks.zh: 內毒素（Endotoxin）不能被過濾器挡住，也不能被蒸汽滅菌消除。唯一可靠的去除方法是乾熱除熱原（通常 250°C 以上）。這就是為什麼玻璃瓶與安瓶通常需經過除熱原通道處理。
blocks.en: Endotoxin cannot be retained by filters and cannot be eliminated by steam sterilization. The only reliable removal method is dry-heat depyrogenation (typically above 250°C). This is why glass vials and ampoules usually pass through a depyrogenation tunnel.

blocks.zh: 思考練習：風險評估實作
blocks.en: Exercise: Risk Assessment in Practice

blocks.zh: 假設你的 CDMO 生產線有一台配液槽、過濾管路與填充平台三個站點：
blocks.en: Suppose your CDMO production line has three stations: a compounding tank, a filtration line, and a filling platform:

blocks.zh: 哪些部件屬於「關鍵部件」？
blocks.en: Which parts are "critical parts"?

blocks.zh: 各站點的 Dirty Hold Time 應設定為多久？
blocks.en: What Dirty Hold Time should be set for each station?

blocks.zh: 如何透過風險評估確定清潔流程的優先順序？
blocks.en: How would you use a risk assessment to prioritize the cleaning processes?

blocks.zh: Single-Use Systems 一次性使用系統
blocks.en: Single-Use Systems

blocks.zh: 一次性系統的關鍵優勢
blocks.en: Key Advantages of Single-Use Systems

blocks.zh: 一次性系統最大的價值在於「消除清潔驗證」與「降低交叉污染風險」。對於 CDMO 而言，這代表更快的產品切換速度與更低的每批次驗證負擔。
blocks.en: The greatest value of single-use systems is that they "eliminate cleaning validation" and "reduce the risk of cross-contamination". For a CDMO, this means faster product changeover and a lower validation burden per batch.

blocks.zh: 比喻：免洗餐具 vs. 磁器餐具
blocks.en: Analogy: Disposable Tableware vs. Porcelain Tableware

blocks.zh: 一次性系統就像用免洗餐具開派對——不用洗碟，用完即丢，操作簡單；但每次都要買新的，累積起來成本不低。傳統不鏽鋼系統就像高級磁器餐具——一次買貴，但洗復使用，長期成本較低。
blocks.en: A single-use system is like throwing a party with disposable tableware: no dishes to wash, you throw everything away after use, and it is simple to handle; but you have to buy new ones every time, and the cost adds up. A traditional stainless steel system is like fine porcelain: it costs more up front, but you wash and reuse it, so the long-term cost is lower.

blocks.zh: 導入時程警告
blocks.en: Implementation Timeline Warning

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別提醒：一次性系統的導入時程「遠比設施設計本身還長」。這包括薄膜選擇、供應商稽核、E&L測試、完整性測試驗證等。CDMO 應在設施設計階段即啟動這些活動，不要等到設施落成才開始。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically warns that the implementation timeline for single-use systems is "much longer than the facility design itself". This includes film selection, supplier audits, E&L testing, and integrity test validation. A CDMO should start these activities during the facility design phase rather than waiting until the facility is built.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實戰：混合策略
blocks.en: CDMO in Practice: A Hybrid Strategy

blocks.zh: 多數 CDMO 採用混合策略：對於高價值小批量產品（如細胞治療）使用一次性系統，對於大規模量產產品繼續使用不鏽鋼固定設備。關鍵是在設施規劃時就預留足夠的柔性空間。
blocks.en: Most CDMOs adopt a hybrid strategy: single-use systems for high-value, small-batch products (such as cell therapy), and fixed stainless steel equipment for large-scale products. The key is to reserve enough flexible space during facility planning.

blocks.zh: 單向流原則
blocks.en: The Unidirectional Flow Principle

blocks.zh: 設備流向與人員流向、物料流向一樣重要。核心原則是：臟污設備與潔淨設備絕對不能在同一區域交會。通過式清洗機和高壓滅菌鍋的使用，確保設備從「臟側」進入、從「潔側」取出。
blocks.en: Equipment flow is as important as personnel flow and material flow. The core principle is that dirty equipment and clean equipment must never meet in the same area. Pass-through washers and autoclaves ensure that equipment enters from the "dirty side" and is removed from the "clean side".

blocks.zh: 比喻：大樓的貨梯與客梯
blocks.en: Analogy: Freight Elevator vs. Passenger Elevator in a Building

blocks.zh: 這就像高級飯店的動線設計：垃圾走貨梯，客人走客梯，絕不交叉。無菌製造設施的臟污設備與潔淨設備也必須走不同的路徑。
blocks.en: This is like the circulation design of a high-end hotel: garbage uses the freight elevator and guests use the passenger elevator, and the two never cross. In a sterile manufacturing facility, dirty equipment and clean equipment must likewise follow separate paths.

blocks.zh: 多產品設施的額外挑戰
blocks.en: Additional Challenges in Multi-Product Facilities

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 的多產品設施，交叉污染風險不僅是 batch-to-batch，還包括 Product A 到 Product B 的污染。因此需要更嚴格的設備分區儲放和流向管理。
blocks.en: In a CDMO multi-product facility, the cross-contamination risk is not only batch-to-batch but also from Product A to Product B. This calls for stricter segregated storage of equipment and tighter flow management.

blocks.zh: Cleaning Equipment 清潔設備
blocks.en: Cleaning Equipment

blocks.zh: 自動化清潔的三個層次
blocks.en: Three Levels of Automated Cleaning

blocks.zh: 半自動（超音波浴、部件清洗機）：適合需要拆卸的部件，例如填充泵
blocks.en: Semi-automated (ultrasonic baths, parts washers): suited to parts that must be disassembled, such as filling pumps

blocks.zh: 全自動 CIP：適合配液槽、管路等固定設備，不需拆卸
blocks.en: Fully automated CIP: suited to fixed equipment such as compounding tanks and piping, with no disassembly required

blocks.zh: 手動清潔：應儘量避免，因為可重複性差，但某些特殊部件仍無可避免
blocks.en: Manual cleaning: should be avoided wherever possible because of poor repeatability, although some special parts remain unavoidable

blocks.zh: CIP 設計六大要素
blocks.en: Six Key Elements of CIP Design

blocks.zh: 消除死角（Dead Legs）：管路中清潔液流不到的地方
blocks.en: Elimination of dead legs: places in the piping that the cleaning solution cannot reach

blocks.zh: 充足流速：確保紐流（Turbulent Flow）以徹底清除殘留
blocks.en: Adequate flow velocity: ensure turbulent flow to remove residues thoroughly

blocks.zh: 完全可排水性：管路不能有積水點
blocks.en: Complete drainability: no pooling points in the piping

blocks.zh: 高低點清潔：管路的最高與最低點都要能被清潔到
blocks.en: High and low point cleaning: both the highest and lowest points of the piping must be cleanable

blocks.zh: 系統乾燥：殘留水分會促進微生物生長
blocks.en: System drying: residual moisture promotes microbial growth

blocks.zh: 表面粗糙度（Ra 值）：表面越光滑越容易清潔
blocks.en: Surface roughness (Ra value): the smoother the surface, the easier it is to clean

blocks.zh: 噴淋裝置的機械故障風險
blocks.en: Mechanical Failure Risk of Spray Devices

blocks.zh: 動態噴淋裝置和靜態噴淋球都可能因機械故障或堵塞而失效。必須透過流程控制或儀表監控（如流量計、轉速感測器）來確保清潔效果的一致性。
blocks.en: Both dynamic spray devices and static spray balls can fail through mechanical malfunction or blockage. Process controls or instrument monitoring (such as flow meters and rotation speed sensors) must be used to ensure consistent cleaning performance.

blocks.zh: 比喻：家用洗碗機 vs. 工業級 CIP
blocks.en: Analogy: Household Dishwasher vs. Industrial CIP

blocks.zh: 家用洗碗機有固定的噴水臂和溫度設定，但你不會把鍋子直接接在洗碗機上。CIP 就是讓清潔液「流進鍋子裡面」，直接在設備內部循環清洗，不需拆卸。
blocks.en: A household dishwasher has fixed spray arms and temperature settings, but you would never connect a pot directly to the dishwasher. CIP lets the cleaning solution "flow through the inside of the pot", circulating and cleaning directly inside the equipment without disassembly.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實戰：標準化清潔設備配置
blocks.en: CDMO in Practice: Standardizing Cleaning Equipment Configuration

blocks.zh: 在多套件生產設施中，建議每條產線採用相同型號的部件清洗機和 CIP 系統。這樣不僅減少驗證成本，還能讓操作員在不同產線之間無縫調動。
blocks.en: In a multi-suite production facility, it is advisable for every line to use the same model of parts washer and CIP system. This not only reduces validation cost but also allows operators to move seamlessly between lines.

blocks.zh: 潔淨室與機械區的分隔
blocks.en: Separating the Cleanroom from the Mechanical Area

blocks.zh: 清潔設備的放置位置是設施設計的重要決策。核心原則：把產生噪音、濕氣和維護需求的機械部分放在潔淨室外面，只讓潔淨操作面面向潔淨區。
blocks.en: Where to place cleaning equipment is an important facility design decision. The core principle: put the parts that generate noise, humidity, and maintenance needs outside the cleanroom, so that only the clean operating face faces the clean area.

blocks.zh: 排水口的污染風險
blocks.en: Contamination Risk of Drains

blocks.zh: 排水口是潔淨室中已知的污染風險點，因為高濕度環境利於微生物生長。ISPE 建議將排水口放在機械區而非潔淨區內，這與 EU GMP Annex 1 對 Grade A/B 區域禁止設置排水口的要求一致。
blocks.en: Drains are a known contamination risk point in cleanrooms because a high-humidity environment favors microbial growth. ISPE recommends locating drains in the mechanical area rather than inside the cleanroom, which is consistent with the EU GMP Annex 1 requirement that prohibits drains in Grade A/B areas.

blocks.zh: Steam Sterilization 蒸汽滅菌
blocks.en: Steam Sterilization

blocks.zh: 滅菌三步驟：滅菌 → 保護 → 轉移
blocks.en: Three Steps of Sterilization: Sterilize, Protect, Transfer

blocks.zh: 滅菌不只是「放進滅菌鍋」這麼簡單。完整的滅菌流程包括三個階段：有效滅菌、防污染儲放、安全轉移到無菌區。任何一個環節失敗，都等於整個滅菌無效。
blocks.en: Sterilization is not as simple as "putting items in the autoclave". The complete sterilization process has three stages: effective sterilization, contamination-protected storage, and safe transfer into the aseptic area. If any one step fails, the whole sterilization is invalidated.

blocks.zh: F0 值的意義
blocks.en: The Meaning of the F0 Value

blocks.zh: F0 是衡量濕熱滅菌效果的標準單位，表示在 121.1°C 下的等價滅菌時間（分鐘）。Overkill 方法要求最小 F0 為 12 分鐘，確保即使在最差情況下也能完全滅菌。
blocks.en: F0 is the standard unit for measuring the effectiveness of moist heat sterilization, expressed as the equivalent sterilization time (in minutes) at 121.1°C. The overkill approach requires a minimum F0 of 12 minutes, ensuring complete sterilization even under worst-case conditions.

blocks.zh: 蒸汽品質：常被忽略的關鍵因素
blocks.en: Steam Quality: A Frequently Overlooked Critical Factor

blocks.zh: 蒸汽的乾燥度、過熱和不凝縮氣體含量直接影響滅菌效果。濕蒸汽含有太多水分會導致裝載濕潤，過熱蒸汽則減少熱傳遞效率。建議定期測試蒸汽品質，特別是新設施或蒸汽系統變更後。
blocks.en: Steam dryness, superheat, and non-condensable gas content directly affect sterilization effectiveness. Wet steam contains too much water and leaves the load wet, while superheated steam reduces heat transfer efficiency. Steam quality should be tested regularly, especially for new facilities or after changes to the steam system.

blocks.zh: 比喻：烤箱與滅菌鍋
blocks.en: Analogy: The Oven and the Autoclave

blocks.zh: 高壓滅菌鍋就像烤箱：你需要確保溫度均勻（溫度記錄）、食物放對位置（裝載圖）、預熱足夠（排氣），而且要用溫度計確認熬到位（生物指示劑）。
blocks.en: An autoclave is like an oven: you need to ensure uniform temperature (temperature mapping), place the food in the right position (load pattern), preheat sufficiently (air removal), and use a thermometer to confirm it is cooked through (biological indicators).

blocks.zh: 思考練習：滅菌確效規劃
blocks.en: Exercise: Sterilization Validation Planning

blocks.zh: 您的 CDMO 要為一台新的雙門高壓滅菌鍋進行確效，請列出：
blocks.en: Your CDMO is to validate a new double-door autoclave. List the following:

blocks.zh: 需要驗證的裝載類型（至少三種）
blocks.en: The load types to be validated (at least three)

blocks.zh: 每種裝載的最大與最小配置
blocks.en: The maximum and minimum configuration for each load

blocks.zh: 如何確定溫度最差點位置
blocks.en: How to determine the worst-case temperature location

blocks.zh: 排氣測試的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Air Removal Testing

blocks.zh: 空氣是蒸汽滅菌的最大敵人。空氣的導熱係數遠低於飽和蒸汽，如果裝載中殘留空氣，該區域的溫度將無法達到滅菌要求。Bowie-Dick 測試或 DART 測試是驗證空氣去除效果的日常工具。
blocks.en: Air is the greatest enemy of steam sterilization. The thermal conductivity of air is far lower than that of saturated steam, so if air remains in the load, the temperature in that area will not reach the sterilization requirement. The Bowie-Dick test or the DART test is a routine tool for verifying air removal.

blocks.zh: 包裝設計：滅菌 vs. 無菌保護的平衡
blocks.en: Packaging Design: Balancing Sterilization and Sterile Protection

blocks.zh: 包裝必須同時滿足兩個矛盾需求：滅菌時要讓蒸汽穿透（透氣性），滅菌後又要阻擋微生物（屏障性）。多層包裝設計（如雙層 breather bag）讓操作員在轉移過程中逐層去除外層。
blocks.en: Packaging must meet two conflicting requirements at once: it must let steam penetrate during sterilization (breathability) and block microorganisms after sterilization (barrier property). Multi-layer packaging designs (such as a double-layer breather bag) let operators remove the outer layers one at a time during transfer.

blocks.zh: RTP vs. VHP 氣閉 — 轉移技術選擇
blocks.en: RTP vs. VHP Airlock: Choosing a Transfer Technology

blocks.zh: RTP（快速轉移埠）：適用於隔離器技術，通過機械密封實現無菌轉移
blocks.en: RTP (rapid transfer port): suited to isolator technology, achieving aseptic transfer through a mechanical seal

blocks.zh: VHP 氣閉：使用過氧化氫滅菌的自動氣閉，適合 RABS 和隔離器
blocks.en: VHP airlock: an automated airlock that uses hydrogen peroxide sterilization, suited to RABS and isolators

blocks.zh: 兩者均優於傳統的手動消毒液噴灑方法。
blocks.en: Both are superior to the traditional method of manually spraying disinfectant.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實戰：高壓滅菌鍋產能規劃
blocks.en: CDMO in Practice: Autoclave Capacity Planning

blocks.zh: 高壓滅菌鍋往往是無菌製造的產能瓶頸。建議在設計階段充分評估：每天所需滅菌循環數量、每個循環時間（含升溫、保溫、乾燥）、日常測試占用時間，確保不會成為生產瓶頸。
blocks.en: The autoclave is often the capacity bottleneck in sterile manufacturing. At the design stage, evaluate thoroughly the number of sterilization cycles needed per day, the time of each cycle (including heat-up, hold, and drying), and the time taken by routine testing, to ensure it does not become a production bottleneck.

blocks.zh: Sterilize-In-Place (SIP) 定位蒸汽滅菌 (SIP)
blocks.en: Sterilize-In-Place (SIP)

blocks.zh: SIP 的兩種應用場景
blocks.en: Two Application Scenarios for SIP

blocks.zh: 固定系統 SIP：大型儲槽、產線管路直接通蒸汽滅菌，不需拆卸
blocks.en: Fixed system SIP: large tanks and line piping are sterilized directly with steam, with no disassembly

blocks.zh: 可移動式 SIP（Steam Out of Place）：將小型容器送到專用 CIP/SIP 站進行滅菌
blocks.en: Mobile SIP (Steam Out of Place): small vessels are taken to a dedicated CIP/SIP station for sterilization

blocks.zh: 封閉系統的革命性意義
blocks.en: The Transformative Significance of Closed Systems

blocks.zh: 隨著焊接管器、無菌連接器和封閉添加裝置的成熟，製程系統可以設計為完全封閉系統。這意味著即使安裝在 ISO 8 或 CNC 區域也能保持無菌，大幅降低對高等級潔淨室的依賴。
blocks.en: With the maturing of tube welders, sterile connectors, and closed addition devices, process systems can be designed as fully closed systems. This means sterility can be maintained even when installed in an ISO 8 or CNC area, greatly reducing reliance on higher-grade cleanrooms.

blocks.zh: 比喻：半牆 — 位前台與後台的分隔
blocks.en: Analogy: The Half Wall, Separating Front of House from Back of House

blocks.zh: 「半牆」或分體式設計就像餐廳的廚房窗口：你只看到乾淨的出餐面，而爐灶、管線、熱水器都藏在後面。SIP 系統的蒸汽閤、冷凝水排放和控制元件都放在機械側，潔淨側只有無菌製程路徑。
blocks.en: A "half wall" or split-body design is like the kitchen pass-through window of a restaurant: you see only the clean serving side, while the stoves, piping, and water heaters are hidden behind. In an SIP system, the steam valves, condensate drainage, and control components are all placed on the mechanical side, leaving only the sterile process path on the clean side.

blocks.zh: SIP 四大設計挑戰
blocks.en: Four Major SIP Design Challenges

blocks.zh: 排氣：管路系統比高壓滅菌鍋容易排氣（沒有多孔載荷），但大型系統需要多點注汽與門序列控制
blocks.en: Air removal: piping systems are easier to air-purge than autoclaves (there is no porous load), but large systems need multiple steam injection points and door sequence control

blocks.zh: 通氣過濾器保護：高溫時過濾器耐壓能力大幅下降，必須限制跨過濾器的流量
blocks.en: Vent filter protection: at high temperature the pressure resistance of the filter drops significantly, so flow across the filter must be limited

blocks.zh: 冷凝水排放：避免群組捕水器（Group Trapping），否則會導致不均勻的冷凝水排放
blocks.en: Condensate drainage: avoid group trapping, which leads to uneven condensate drainage

blocks.zh: 乾燥與冷卻：使用 0.2 µm 無菌過濾空氣或氮氣，維持正壓直到使用
blocks.en: Drying and cooling: use 0.2 µm sterile-filtered air or nitrogen and maintain positive pressure until use

blocks.zh: 思考練習：溫度感測器佈局
blocks.en: Exercise: Temperature Sensor Layout

blocks.zh: 您要為一套包含配液槽、兩條過濾管路和填充槽的 SIP 系統規劃溫度感測器佈局：
blocks.en: You are to plan the temperature sensor layout for an SIP system consisting of a compounding tank, two filtration lines, and a filling tank:

blocks.zh: 潛在冷點在哪裡？（提示：獨立流路末端）
blocks.en: Where are the potential cold spots? (Hint: the ends of independent flow paths)

blocks.zh: 哪些位置需要感測器來偵測蒸汽捕水器故障？
blocks.en: Which locations need sensors to detect steam trap failure?

blocks.zh: 如何用壓力與溫度的對比來確認飽和蒸汽的存在？
blocks.en: How can the comparison of pressure and temperature be used to confirm the presence of saturated steam?

blocks.zh: Other Sterilization Methods 其他滅菌方法
blocks.en: Other Sterilization Methods

blocks.zh: 薰蒸滅菌的限制
blocks.en: Limitations of Fumigation

blocks.zh: 薰蒸劑必須能「直接接觸」目標表面且達到足夠濃度才能有效。這意味著被遮擋的表面（如裝載堆疊的內側）可能無法被充分薰蒸。這也是為什麼薰蒸不能取代常規的清潔與消毒程序。
blocks.en: The fumigant must come into "direct contact" with the target surface at a sufficient concentration to be effective. This means shielded surfaces (such as the inner side of stacked loads) may not be adequately fumigated. This is also why fumigation cannot replace routine cleaning and disinfection procedures.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實戰：委外滅菌的供應鏈管理
blocks.en: CDMO in Practice: Supply Chain Management for Outsourced Sterilization

blocks.zh: 由於伽瑪射線和 EtO 滅菌通常委外處理，CDMO 需要關注：滅菌後組件的儲存條件與位置、有效期管理（通常兩年）、供應商的劑量稽核計畫。這些都應納入定期供應商管理流程。
blocks.en: Because gamma irradiation and EtO sterilization are usually outsourced, a CDMO needs to pay attention to the storage conditions and location of components after sterilization, shelf-life management (typically two years), and the supplier's dose audit program. All of these should be included in the regular supplier management process.

blocks.zh: 核心重點摘要
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 清潔、消毒與滅菌是無菌製造的三道防線，設備設計必須從一開始就考慮這三個面向
blocks.en: Cleaning, disinfection, and sterilization are the three lines of defense in sterile manufacturing, and equipment design must consider all three from the very beginning

blocks.zh: 關鍵部件（產品接觸面）需要風險評估、臟污/潔淨保留時間管理及清潔驗證
blocks.en: Critical parts (product-contact surfaces) require risk assessment, dirty/clean hold time management, and cleaning validation

blocks.zh: 一次性系統是 CDMO 的利器，但導入時程長於設施設計，需提前啟動
blocks.en: Single-use systems are a powerful tool for a CDMO, but their implementation timeline is longer than the facility design and must be started early

blocks.zh: 設備流向必須單向，臟污與潔淨絕對分離，對 CDMO 多產品設施尤其重要
blocks.en: Equipment flow must be unidirectional, with dirty and clean kept strictly separate, which is especially important in a CDMO multi-product facility

blocks.zh: CIP 設計關鍵：消除死角、充足流速、完全可排水、適當表面粗糙度
blocks.en: Key CIP design points: eliminate dead legs, adequate flow velocity, complete drainability, appropriate surface roughness

blocks.zh: 蒸汽滅菌（高壓鍋 + SIP）的 F0 ≥ 12 分鐘，需驗證排氣、冷凝水排放、溫度記錄與生物指示劑
blocks.en: Steam sterilization (autoclave + SIP) requires F0 ≥ 12 minutes, and validation of air removal, condensate drainage, temperature recording, and biological indicators

blocks.zh: 大型 SIP 系統採用封閉設計與半牆安裝，減少對潔淨室的影響
blocks.en: Large SIP systems use closed designs and half-wall installation to reduce the impact on the cleanroom

blocks.zh: VHP、伽瑪射線、EtO 各有專屬應用場景，CDMO 需管好委外滅菌的供應鏈與有效期
blocks.en: VHP, gamma irradiation, and EtO each have their own application scenarios, and a CDMO needs to manage the outsourced sterilization supply chain and shelf life
